Scene 03

Scene 03

Walter Skinner

Where's agent Scully?

John Doggett

Running late. What do we have?

Walter Skinner

One of our men doing routine surveillance on a cult group-- the ibogan temple. We had a tip they were trafficking narcotics. Nobody suspected anything like this. Agent james leeds. Six-year veteran of the bureau, father of two. Patrol cop found him. Car was locked from the inside.

John Doggett

Nobody saw or heard anything?

Walter Skinner

No.

John Doggett

This couldn't have happened here.

Walter Skinner

Blood splatter on the seat says it did.

John Doggett

It's too narrow. There's no room to swing the weapon. Besides, it doesn't make any sense. The gun's still holstered and the key's in the ignition. Even if he fell asleep--

[ sighs ]

John Doggett

This is damn weird.

Walter Skinner

It gets weirder. These people were all killed the same way as our guy. All 20 cult members dead from a single deep wound to the forehead.

John Doggett

Is this every member?

Walter Skinner

Except one. Their leader, anthony tipet, is missing. Tipet was a convicted murderer who claimed to have found god. We didn't think we were dealing with an apocalyptic cult. We've seen this kind of thing before. Jonestown, heaven's gate.

John Doggett

I don't care how devoted they were. These people wouldn't just lie here and let their leader bash their brains in. I got to figure at least one of them would have had a problem with that.

Walter Skinner

It's something I've considered. I'm running tox tests on all the bodies for drugs.

John Doggett

Does that include our man in the car?

Agent Crane

A.d. Skinner? We're still unable to locate agent stedman.

John Doggett

Angus stedman?

Walter Skinner

Leeds' partner. Do you know him?

John Doggett

Where'd you look?

Agent Crane

He wasn't checked into the same motel as leeds. He's not answering his cell or his pager.

John Doggett

Did you check his condo?

Agent Crane

His condo?

John Doggett

Yeah, stedman's from pittsburgh. He keeps a condo here that belonged to his folks.

Scene 05

Scene 05

Anthony Tipet

The body is but clay... A shell made by god to hold the twin aspects of the holy spirit: light and dark. If we have the courage to see into darkness we see into god... Free of the clay which confines us.

Walter Skinner

Anthony tipet served 12 years for the bludgeoning death of his wife. After his release, he became a minister preaching a hybrid of evangelical and eastern religions. He claimed a higher plane of being could be reached by the via negativa-- the path of darkness-- the plane closer to god. Once reached, it would let the spirit travel unhindered. Tipet believed hallucinogens would lead him to this plane-- specifically compounds of the bark of an african tree... The iboga.

Senior Agent

You're saying all these people were so stoned on this bark they just let their leader kill them?

Walter Skinner

We found no trace of the drug in the blood in any of the victims.

Alvin Kersh

I don't understand. How in the hell did tipet manage to slaughter all these people?

John Doggett

Tipet was paranoid but nothing indicates he was ready to take the lives of his own people or our men.

Alvin Kersh

This is our one and only suspect. Are you telling me he didn't do it?

John Doggett

Whoever did this left not even a trace how: no prints, no forensic evidence whatsoever. Agent leeds' sedan, the cult house, agent stedman's condo were all locked from the inside.

Alvin Kersh

That's impossible.

Walter Skinner

Unless tipet took the drug and succeeded. Unless his consciousness was there but his body was somewhere else.

Alvin Kersh

The X-File explanation. I take it this theory comes from agent Scully?

John Doggett

Agent Scully has yet to reach any conclusions, sir.

Alvin Kersh

That's the problem. I'm not hearing conclusions from either one of you. If this man has reached a higher plane then explain to me why 22 people are dead including two FBI agents. Now I want to hear what you're going to do about it.

John Doggett

If I'm working this case, I'd appreciate a heads up before you tell the deputy director any more science fiction stories.

Walter Skinner

Hey, I don't have another explanation.

John Doggett

Those guys in there are right. This whole story doesn't make a damn bit of sense.

Walter Skinner

I'm supposed to give those guys in there answers, agent Doggett. You're supposed to help me do that.

John Doggett

Tipet's on the run. Find him, and we just might.

Scene 08

4:07 AM

John Doggett

Sir?

Walter Skinner

I think we caught a break. A homeless man was found dead in pittsburgh two hours ago. I had them e-mail me some digital photos.

John Doggett

Walter Skinner

John Doggett

Walter Skinner

John Doggett

Well, I'm supposed to believe this guy doped his way into another plane of reality? That his spirit is going around killing people?

Walter Skinner

All right, just suppose-- suppose that this drug finally did what tipet said it would. That his spirit could be in one place while his body was in another.

John Doggett

Then tell me why he's doing it. If he's looking for god, why is he killing people? Just 'cause I'm assigned to the X-Files you want me to think like Scully or Mulder would. You got the wrong guy. I need facts, not wild ideas.

Walter Skinner

All right. Then consider this one. I had pittsburgh p.d. Check the log on that pay phone.

John Doggett

10:12 p.m., a call was placed to one andre bormanis.

Walter Skinner

He's a convicted drug dealer that served time with tipet. That number's a D.C. Area code.

[ knocking ]

[ knocking insistently ]
